notes: Sales-to-dealer movement is now measured in EUR, not pieces. Root cause fixed in the builder: _build/build_kickback_jump_case.py load_sellout() previously read the dealer files with usecols limited to period/period_grain/qty and so could only produce a unit ratio; it now reads part_number as well and values each line at the median ISZE net billed price per part number (the method already used by _eurostd_20261007_build.py and _analyze_stock_d_20261007.py, reused not invented). The euro figure is the dealer's volume measured at OUR prices, not the distributor's selling price, which is not on file: the direction of the movement is the reading, a level against our own billing is a price-ladder difference and not a margin. The corrected v2 deck (ISZE_Kickback_Management_Revised_v2_2026-10-07.pptx), which had the slide deleted, was NOT touched. The six archive copies under _build/_backup were NOT touched. Visual QA: every slide of each deck was rendered to PNG via PowerPoint COM (Slide.Export, 1600x900) and every PNG was image-Read by this agent, one at a time, at full resolution.
